header.title: QTL Explorer
descriptionLines: Search PanKgraph QTL data to explore regulatory relationships between genetic variants and genes.
Select how you would like to configure your question and proceed to QTL results.

configureSection.title: Configure your QTL question
configureSection.subtitle: Choose how you want to search

modes.title: Search by Gene
modes.description: Find SNPs that may regulate a selected gene through QTL evidence.
modes.exampleQuestion: Which SNP serves as the lead QTL for INS?
modes.searchHint: Enter a gene to retrieve potentially related QTL lead SNPs.
modes.primaryPlaceholder: Enter gene symbol or Ensembl ID (e.g., INS or ENSG00000254647)
modes.questionTemplate: Which SNP serves as the lead QTL for [GENE]?

modes.title: Search by SNP
modes.description: Find genes potentially regulated by a selected SNP.
modes.exampleQuestion: Which gene is regulated by rs2402203 as a QTL?
modes.searchHint: Enter an SNP to retrieve genes potentially associated by QTL evidence.
modes.primaryPlaceholder: Enter rsID or genomic coordinate (e.g., rs123456 or chr1:1234567)
modes.questionTemplate: Which gene is regulated by [SNP] as a QTL?

modes.title: Search by SNP + Gene
modes.description: Check whether a specific SNP-gene pair is supported by QTL evidence.
modes.exampleQuestion: Does rs123456 serve as a QTL for INS?
modes.searchHint: Enter the SNP and gene to check whether this pair has QTL evidence.
modes.primaryPlaceholder: Enter rsID or genomic coordinate (e.g., rs123456 or chr1:1234567)
modes.secondaryPlaceholder: Enter gene symbol or Ensembl ID (e.g., INS or ENSG00000254647)
modes.questionTemplate: Does [SNP] serve as a QTL for [GENE]?

shared.infoBar: PanKgraph QTL currently focuses on Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) and uses a fixed population.
shared.whatNextDescription: PanKgraph will check whether this SNP-gene pair exists in the QTL database and take you to the QTL results page with evidence, association statistics, and linked knowledge.

workflow.title: QTL Results
workflow.text: View results and context in PanKgraph

shared.securityNote: All queries are processed securely. No data will be stored.
shared.bottomSearchPlaceholder: Ask about QTLs, genes, SNPs, or regulatory evidence... (e.g., "Does rs123456 serve as a QTL for INS?")
shared.bottomSearchHint: Your message will be sent with the current QTL search configuration.

rightPanel.aboutBody: PanKgraph QTL integrates variant-to-gene regulatory evidence to support exploration of genetic regulation in pancreatic and T1D-relevant contexts.
importantBodyLines: This tool is designed for exploratory lookup and knowledge discovery.
It checks whether QTL evidence exists in PanKgraph; it does not perform new QTL mapping or causal inference.
whyItems: Search regulatory evidence from either gene or variant direction
Connect QTL signals to PanKgraph genes, variants, GWAS, pathways, and ontology annotations
Move directly from query configuration to structured QTL results
